sessions.intent: Design an OBP animation library (PLang app + JS runtime) distilled from aniva/rafbokin/coder animations, then a beginner PLang lesson built with it

before.assumptions: Three bots built near-identical canvas animation engines; the reusable core can be one OBP library. PLang builds/assembles; only the browser player/draw engine is JS.
before.risk: OpenRouter account has no credits (TTS/music blocked); committing on the architect branch app-systems may collide

actions.context: OBP JS engine: root film.this, context film.frame, lesson data sealed; ported best-of aniva/rafbokin/coder with origin comments; offline-baked soundtrack (music+cues+voice+ducking) played from offset; code blocks as real DOM text; smoke test in chromium: no errors, voice intelligible over music (verified by transcription), peak -0.5 dBFS
12+4 Gemini 3.8 TTS samples; found instructions field + lowercase plang needed; Ingi chose Achird on flash-lite
